transcript:
# COMMITTEE ON FINANCE
**May 19, 2026 Upon Recess of the BMA**

Mayor Ruais called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Kaw-uh, Goonan, Dexter, Fajardo, Bonilla, Kantor, Trisciani, O’Neil, Terrio, Sapienza, Burkush, Barry, Vincent, Thomas

## 1. Resolutions:

“Amending the FY2022 Community Improvement Program, authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of Twenty-Two Thousand Eight Hundred Dollars ($22,800) for the FY2022 CIP 212122 ARPA - Healthy Food Access Strategic Plan & Implementation”

“Amending the FY2026 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and appropriating funds in the amount of Twenty Thousand Dollars ($20,000) for the FY2026 CIP C410021626School Based Dental Program - Medicaid”

“Amending the FY2026 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and appropriating funds in the amount of Nine Hundred Forty-Three Thousand Eight Hundred Ninety-Four Dollars ($943,894) for the FY2026 CIP C410022126 Public Health Preparedness”

“Amending the FY2026 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and appropriating funds in the amount of Thirty-Two Thousand Dollars ($32,000) for the FY2026 CIPC650050126 Parks Deferred Maintenance”

*On motion of Alderman Terrio, duly seconded by Alderman O’Neil, it was voted to read by titles only.*

*On motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Barry, it was voted to waive the reading by titles only.*

*On motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Burkush, it was voted that the Resolutions ought to pass and be Enrolled.*

## 2. Budget Authorizations:

- 211918 NACCHO - Focus on Opioid Epidemic
- 212025 Endowment for Health - Homeless Healthcare Grant
- 212122 ARPA - Healthy Food Access Strategic Plan & Implementation
- 212322 ARPA - Community Health Worker Program
- 212417 2016 Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Culture of Health Prize
- 212420 Public Health and Safety Toolkit (PHAST)
- 212619 Support Technology for Community Care Coordination
- 411025 ARPA - MPD Bonuses/Hiring (10 Officers)
- 411624 Smart Policing Initiative
- 710618 WWTP Solids Train Upgrade-Design
- 710824 Secondary Clarifier Design and Construction
- 711021 CSO Study, Design and Construction
- 711122 CSO Cemetery Brook - Design
- 711124 Solids Disposal Master Plan
- 711222 CSO Optimization/Controls
- 714424 Carpenter Library Interior Abatement & Painting
- 810425 Facade Improvement Program
- C270071426 CMOM C-6 Design - Enterprise
- C270071526 MS4-FY26 Study & Design - Enterprise
- C270071726 50/50 Backflow Prevention Program-Enterprise
- C410020125 Bloomberg Opportunity Youth Collaborative - Amplifying Youth Voice
- C410021626 School Based Dental Program - Medicaid
- C410022126 Public Health Preparedness
- C650050126 Parks Deferred Maintenance

*On motion of Alderman Trisciani, duly seconded by Alderman O’Neil, it was voted that the Budget Authorizations be approved subject to final adoption of related Resolutions.*

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman O’Neil, duly seconded by Alderman Dexter, it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

City Clerk

*Meeting Start Time: 8:58PM*
*Meeting End Time: 8:59PM*
*Minutes Prepared By: Michael Intranuovo*
headline: Approved four resolutions funding FY2022 and FY2026 Community Improvement Program items and related budget authorizations subject to final adoption.
summary: The committee reviewed four resolutions amending the FY2022 and FY2026 Community Improvement Program, covering funds for a Healthy Food Access plan, a School Based Dental Program, Public Health Preparedness, and Parks Deferred Maintenance. The resolutions were voted to pass and be enrolled, and a list of budget authorizations was approved subject to final adoption of the related resolutions.
decisions: Voted that the Resolutions ought to pass and be Enrolled.
Voted that the Budget Authorizations be approved subject to final adoption of related Resolutions.
